name: funnel-runtime
description: Configurable multi-step funnels with versioning, rollback, A/B experiments, idempotent event ingestion and analytics.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @funnel/server" "npm run dev -w @funnel/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @funnel/web && npm run build -w @funnel/server
